# OpenSourceRail Campaign Catalogue
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

Deterministic outreach packages for **266 cities**, **44
countries** and **53 international organisations and media outlets**. No message has
been sent and no unverified public-sector email has been guessed.
